name: Sanjouin Miyaka
source: A daughter of one of the Japan's most prominent families, the Sanjouin house. However, she is super poor because her home is on the verge of the collapse. Miyaka lives with her younger siblings and has to take care of them; in order to do so, she works at a maid cafe. She became one of the wife candidates out of her own will because she believes she could be able to save her family through her decision.
